claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings are NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for two non-jurist-preference views at 144k scale: (1) Citation Heritage — center_projected_64dim AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74; (2) Section Cross-lingual — Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen hierarchy at 1K sample (full corpus BLOCKED); (3) Linear Hybrid Complement — PASS adversarial at 19yr+ with w=0.3-0.4, adds cross-lingual benefit but JP 0.66-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79. TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY product mode; Dense = COMPLEMENTARY modes.
evidence_summary: All evidence_refs from legal-distance.json verified accessible and consistent with reported metrics. Citation heritage: 4/4 dense modes PASS AUC > 0.75 at 22yr (344 positive pairs). Section cross-lingual: 2/3 sections PASS at 1K sample (Sachverhalt 0.282 > 0.2, Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1, Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1). Linear hybrids: PASS both adversarial gates at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4), cross-lang recall improves 0.124→0.160 but < 0.2 threshold. Two-mode tradeoff reproduced at 6 scales. True OOS ceiling ~0.53 confirmed. Data blockers explicitly identified.
